description: This file implements an image generation module supporting multiple providers (LiteLLM and OpenRouter). It contains functions to generate images asynchronously using provider-specific APIs, handles external dependencies, and processes responses into a unified multimodal format.

methods.name: generate_image_litellm
methods.description: Asynchronously generates an image using LiteLLM's API, supporting various models and styles, and wraps the response into a multimodal format.

methods.name: generate_image_openrouter
methods.description: Asynchronously generates an image using OpenRouter's chat completion API, extracts images and text from the response, and returns a multimodal response object.
